name: godot
title: Godot Engine documentation

text.attribution: Credit Juan Linietsky, Ariel Manzur and the Godot community; link the page and CC BY 3.0, and indicate alterations.
text.conditions: Applies outside classes/; preserve per-page exceptions and separate third-party asset licences.

code_samples.attribution: Code excerpts from tutorials follow CC BY 3.0 with attribution; classes/ content follows MIT and requires copyright and licence notice.
code_samples.conditions: Do not assume all snippets are MIT. For classes/, preserve separate MIT notices; outside classes/, follow documentation's CC BY terms.

include: tutorials/ for 2D, 3D, scripting, physics, UI and rendering
exclude: Images, fonts, video and third-party assets

expected_size.note: Planning estimate only; no corpus has been fetched or measured.

update_cadence.note: Review upstream weekly; map master to latest and check CC BY/MIT split each refresh.

citation.format: Godot documentation: {title} — {url} (Godot community; CC BY 3.0 or MIT for class reference)
citation.example: Godot documentation: Nodes and scenes — https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/getting_started/step_by_step/nodes_and_scenes.html (Godot community)
